requirement: The system shall validate dual redundant accelerator pedal position sensors (PPS1, PPS2) between 0.5V and 4.5V and reject readings if discrepancy exceeds 0.2V.

constraints.description: Validate PPS1 electrical range between 0.5V and 4.5V
Validate PPS2 electrical range between 0.5V and 4.5V
Reject reading when absolute discrepancy |PPS1 - PPS2| > 0.2V
Emit explicit electrical fault diagnostic status on boundary violation
Return plausible status when all signals satisfy physical criteria
